title: Logos 12 opening: I in the Father and the Father in me
english: Twelfth discourse. On “I am in the Father and the Father in me,” and “I and the Father are one.”
Mutual indwelling and unity are pressed against Arian unlikeness.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
